Name: Aging
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] >= 1 && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] <= 7, "1 - 7 Days",
    RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] >= 8 && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] <= 14, "8 - 14 Days",
    RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] >= 15 && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] <= 30, "15 - 30 Days",
    RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] >= 31 && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] <= 60, "31 - 60 Days",
    RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] > 60 && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceCreationDate] <= 45719, "60+ Days",
    "Not Started"
)

Name: AgingSortOrder
